title: AI-Powered Documentation: Insights with Omer Rosenbaum, CTO of Swim
description:
In this engaging episode, Simon Maple sits down with Omer Rosenbaum, the CTO and co-founder of Swimm, to explore the challenges and solutions in the realm of software documentation. With a rich background in cybersecurity, Omer brings a unique perspective to the discussion, highlighting the critical role of documentation in developer onboarding and knowledge sharing within organizations. They delve into how AI can assist in writing, updating, and finding documentation and discuss Swimm’s innovative approach that combines static analysis with AI to automate the documentation process. This episode is a must-listen for anyone interested in the future of software documentation and the impact of AI on developer workflows.

Chapters:
00:22 Intro – Simon Maple welcomes Omer Rosenbaum and covers his background in cybersecurity.
01:01 Shift to AI and Docs – Omer talks about moving from cybersecurity to AI-driven documentation.
02:16 Defining Docs – Exploring what documentation means in software development.
03:49 Documentation Challenges – The struggle of keeping documentation up-to-date as code changes.
09:11 AI's Role in Docs – How AI can help write, update, and find documentation.
12:09 Swimm's Approach – How Swimm uses static analysis and AI for accurate documentation.
16:18 Static Analysis vs. AI – Finding the balance between static analysis and AI in documentation.
19:06 Workflow Integration – How Swimm integrates into developer tools like IDEs.
21:19 Legacy Code Docs – Tackling the challenge of documenting legacy codebases with AI.
27:03 AI’s Future in Docs – The future impact of AI on documentation and developer workflows.
This version keeps it brief but still covers the key takeaways.
